method: Read-only inspection of released class bytecode; no native gameplay test
verified_findings: BaseBlaster firing wrapper calls the three-argument fireBlaster hook. BubbleHorn overrides that hook and creates BubbleShotEntity.
BaseBlaster.consumeEnergy uses AoAResources.SPIRIT. This is not a conventional bullet-magazine baseline.
BubbleHorn exposes the SLOWS_TARGETS tooltip and an entity-impact potion hook. Exact effect mapping and native behavior still require the release-specific test.
BubbleShotEntity has a BUBBLE_SHOT_POP sound reference and an age-100 removal branch. These observations do not prove the new proposed effects have been implemented.
design_consequence: Preserve released Spirit resource family and original mode. Owner explicitly requested an earned functional mouthpiece with much higher damage, projectile count and speed on 2026-10-22T05:09Z. Do not confuse the original bubble projectile with newly proposed musical presentation or infer final multipliers.
